cat > /workspace/tmp/gen_perf.py <<'PY'
import json, random, sys
random.seed(42)
Q=16;L=8;U=2147483648
R=32
# borders 0..U 33 points
b=[0]+sorted(random.sample(range(1,U),R-1))+[U]
steps=[]
t=0
attempt=0
ids=0
for k in range(40000):
    t += random.randint(1,20)
    serve = (k%3!=1)
    nl=random.randint(0,L)
    lanes=random.sample(range(L),nl)
    arr=[]
    for lane in lanes[:min(nl,3)]:
        arr.append({'id':f'id_{ids}','lane':lane,'rank':random.randrange(U)})
        ids+=1;attempt+=1
    steps.append({'t':t,'serve':serve,'arrivals':arr})
req={'mode':'stream','banks':Q,'lanes':L,'limit':U,'borders':b,'capacity':100,'epoch':7,'steps':steps}
print(json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')))
sys.stderr.write(f'attempts {attempt}\n')
PY
